knowledge:
- key_parameters: X=Training covariate/feature matrix ;; t.class=Training target class vector (factors or integers 1:n) ;; X.TEST=Test covariate/feature matrix ;; t.class.TEST=Test target class vector ;; theta=Vector of initial scale covariance parameters (one per feature) ;; control=List of optional control settings including bThetaEstimate (boolean to enable/disable covariance parameter estimation), bMonitor (boolean to monitor progress), maxIts (maximum iterations), sKernelType (e.g., "iprod" for linear inner product), Thresh (convergence threshold), and bPlotFitting (boolean to plot diagnostics)
- alternatives: SVM multiclass classifier (mentioned as the baseline method compared against in the breast cancer study)
- when_to_use: Use when performing multi-class classification on genomic or clinical datasets where probabilistic class membership, feature selection/weighting (ARD), and non-linear decision boundaries are required.
- pitfalls: Estimating covariance parameters (bThetaEstimate=TRUE) on high-dimensional datasets (e.g., thousands of genes) is computationally intensive; for such data, a linear inner product kernel (sKernelType="iprod") with fixed theta (bThetaEstimate=FALSE) is preferred. Avoid using the placeholder/fake prediction function designed only for package testing.

workflows.name: multiclass_gp_classification_with_ard
workflows.intent: Train a Gaussian Process multinomial probit classifier with Automatic Relevance Determination (ARD) to estimate feature importance and predict classes on low-to-medium dimensional data.
workflows.stages: 1. Initialize covariance scale parameters (theta) and maximum iterations ;; 2. Run variational Bayesian multinomial probit regression using vbmp with theta estimation enabled ;; 3. Compute out-of-sample prediction error using predError ;; 4. Plot convergence and ARD diagnostics using plotDiagnostics

workflows.name: high_dimensional_cross_validation
workflows.intent: Perform cross-validation on high-dimensional gene expression data using a linear inner product kernel without covariance parameter estimation.
workflows.stages: 1. Define a cross-validation prediction function wrapping vbmp with linear inner product kernel and fixed theta ;; 2. Partition data into cross-validation folds ;; 3. Iterate through folds to predict class labels using predClass ;; 4. Calculate the cross-validated error rate
